scope: Bounded stats/one-shot rewards/rate budgets and source-of-truth restore without reward replay; not all permanent state classified
findings: Stats four root numeric fields are authoritative persistent gameplay state. RankPerks.apply derives expected rank from merit and setRank can promote merit to threshold. Calling addMerit/setRank as a migration copy is not neutral; restore exact correctly typed stored values before separately reviewing derived reconciliation.

Merit once-only keys have bounded consumer switch: evt keju/minister/army/qilin/dim_celestial/dim_underworld; seen dragon_crystal/xuantian_jade/dragon_emperor_seal/emperor_bone/jade/phoenix_feather/rebel_head/eunuch_token/sky_token/jade_seal/official_seal/edict/tiger_tally/blueprint/bronze_ingot/silver_ingot/refined_steel/cinnabar. Do not whitelist every dynasty_ prefix because other files own transient state.

Kill-window long and earned int form a paired anti-farming budget (120 per10 real minutes for amount<100), not arbitrary disposable combat cooldown. Dropping them at Clone permits death-based cap bypass; preserve original window and spent count without restarting timer or granting merit.

Weapon gift flags gilded_mace/supreme_sword/seven_star_saber/sunbow and bossKinds int+comma-list prevent periodic and daylight-kill re-awards. OnMobKill records six species, not every firstkill entry. Do not recompute list from ten-entry firstkill table or replay grant API.

Firstkill grants write nested PlayerPersisted receipt and root flag. Existing nested true only prevents duplicate reward; grantFirstKill early-return does not mirror true back to missing root. EquipmentBehaviors.revengeBonus reads root flags directly. Thus surviving nested receipt alone does not establish restored weapon provenance bonus after Clone. Need explicit restore/alias precedence design; do not call grantFirstKill as migration.

RankPerks derived attributes use three stable UUIDs; reapply is idempotent replacement but caller may correct inconsistent rank using merit. Rank_notice is derived UI state, not same as currency ownership.

World tick revisits dimensions and calls awardForEvent which calls Merit.onEvent. Missing one-shot flags can regrant even if advancement already exists. Blind calling event award while restoring state is an economic action.

Manual giveOnce checks root manual_given and writes before item delivery, so losing it can repeat a starter gift on login. Festival_day guards once-per-real-day trigger; scope needs festival reward consumer inspection before final whitelist decision.

School clone already deepcopies its specific root compound; SlotProgression clone merges only its nested milestone subcompound and forgets trinket cache. New migration must coexist, not replace whole PlayerPersisted or invalidate other handlers. Neither existing handler shown restores four root stats.
